records.failureSummary: Verified the render-module helpers in src/render.mjs: escapeHtmlText, escapeAttrUrl and parseInlineLinks all meet the task acceptance criteria. escapeHtmlText replaces & first then <, >, ", ' in a single pass so produced entities are never re-escaped. escapeAttrUrl escapes only &, " and ' and leaves < and > untouched. parseInlineLinks emits text with the label passed through escapeHtmlText, the url through escapeAttrUrl, a double-quoted href, escapes all non-link text, supports multiple links per line and preserves input order without parsing nested brackets. Input is coerced through an asString guard so non-string/nullish trust-boundary values are handled safely. No files needed changing beyond src/render.mjs; no dependencies added. npm run lint and npm run build both exit 0. The renderPage test passes; the sole failing official test is the buildSite test in test/build.test.mjs, which is out of scope for this task (build.mjs is explicitly excluded by TR-1 and owned by a separate build task).
